title: NiFi Flow Inventory + AWS Glue Job Conversion
description: Catalog NiFi flows and convert to AWS Glue ETL jobs and Amazon MSK streaming pipelines.

steps.action: Export NiFi flow inventory: NiFi REST API GET /nifi-api/process-groups/root/flow — document all processors, connections, and controller services
steps.verify: JSON export file with complete flow topology; processor count matches NiFi canvas

steps.action: Classify flows by type: batch ETL (→ Glue Job), real-time streaming (→ MSK + Glue Streaming), file movement (→ S3 + EventBridge)
steps.verify: Classification spreadsheet with flow ID, type, source/target, estimated Glue DPU

steps.action: Create Glue catalog database and crawlers for source data stores (Oracle via JDBC, S3 landing zones)
steps.verify: Glue crawler run succeeds; tables visible in Glue catalog with correct schemas

steps.action: Convert batch NiFi flows to Glue Python/PySpark jobs using Glue Studio visual editor or script editor
steps.verify: Glue job test run completes; output row count matches NiFi flow test output

steps.action: Set up EventBridge Scheduler rules to replace NiFi cron-based processor schedules
steps.verify: Scheduler rule triggers Glue job at correct interval; CloudWatch shows successful invocations
steps.rollback: Disable EventBridge rule; re-enable NiFi cron processor

steps.action: For real-time flows: create MSK cluster, migrate NiFi ListenXxx processors to Kafka producers, NiFi PublishKafka to consumers
steps.verify: MSK producer/consumer lag < 1s; topic message counts match source event rate
steps.rollback: Repoint producers to original NiFi endpoint
